data.title: KSrelief Holds Field Verification Workshop for Emergency Cash Assistance Project in Taiz
data.content:
Taiz, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) held an introductory workshop yesterday for field teams tasked with verifying data on households targeted by an emergency cash assistance project in Taiz Governorate, Yemen.
    The project covers 50,000 households across five districts in the governorate, with each eligible household set to receive SAR1,000 in three installments through a local bank to help meet basic needs.
    The workshop aimed to familiarize field team members with verification mechanisms and procedures, as well as methods for compiling beneficiary lists in line with the project's established criteria and standards.
    The project forms part of the Kingdom's humanitarian efforts, delivered through KSrelief, to support the Yemeni people, alleviate the suffering of vulnerable communities, and improve their living conditions.
    -- SPA
